paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.30% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.71%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.95%). Brent crude changed -2.01% to 90.1. Gold changed -0.49% to 3,723.5. Bitcoin changed +1.07% to 63,660.2305. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.095%, a relative move of +0.57%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-6.96%) and Newmont (-6.05%) moved the most.
